readOnly.help: The Hub can't change this one.
features.title: Agent features
features.body: Instruction files, account failover and chat titles for the agent on this computer.
f.read_agents_md.help: The agent reads the AGENTS.md file in a chat's folder.
f.read_claude_md.help: The agent reads CLAUDE.md in a chat's folder and in its own settings folder.
f.account_rotation.help: When a provider account reaches its limit, the agent moves to another account you signed in with for that provider.
f.session_titles.help: The AI titles a chat from its first messages. A name you set stays; clear it to get an automatic title back.
f.hooks_agent_self_trust: Trust low-risk hook edits you approve
f.hooks_agent_self_trust.help: Low-risk hook edits you approve stay trusted when the hooks already there were trusted. Read only here.
folderMayOverride: A folder's own settings can still change this for chats there.
perRealm: Chats in {{realm}} use {{realm}}'s own setting. The Hub can change this only in the Global realm for now.
perRealmAll: Each realm has its own setting. The Hub can change this only in the Global realm for now.
set.admin: The agent on this computer has its own admin check and refuses this change from the Hub.
set.protected: The agent doesn't let the Hub change this one.
where.title: Folder path rules
where.body: From the settings that apply in this folder. A chat's folder access and places you allowed during a chat also count.
where.allRealms.title: Choose a realm
where.allRealms.body: Each realm has its own settings. Choose one from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to see where its agents may work.
where.noFolder.title: Choose a folder
where.noFolder.body: These paths come from a folder's settings. Choose One folder above to see them.
where.allowed.help: Added beside a chat's folder and the home folder, when the chat's folder access is home.
where.deny.help: Agents may never touch these paths.
where.hidden_one: {{count}} more inside the agent's own folder is not listed.
where.hidden_other: {{count}} more inside the agent's own folder are not listed.
pending.known: A change to {{name}} may have gone through: the agent did not confirm it.
pending.check: Check again reads the setting from the agent.
pending.stop: Once you stop tracking it the switch is free again, and the setting stays as the agent has it.
